mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise significantly above baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4% triggers a tightening cycle, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS >4% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent easing of monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 2%) and weakening labor market conditions (UNRATE < 5%) create a favorable environment for equity growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing and labor market stress
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not rise significantly when both FEDFUNDS < 2% and UNRATE < 5% simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening monetary regime (FEDFUNDS > 4%), rising CPIAUCSL inflation above 2% signals cost-push pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS >4% and CPIAUCSL >2% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong labor market regime (UNRATE < 5%), rapid job growth (PAYEMS > 10,000) signals labor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns fail to rise significantly when UNRATE <5% and PAYEMS >10,000 in a strong labor market regime.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 1%) signals supply-side easing, reducing production bottlenecks and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns do not rise significantly when both CPIAUCSL <2% and FEDFUNDS <1% simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL crossing above 2% triggers expectations of higher inflation, leading to market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL >2% in the same period.
